    Clan and Army

    The army

    An undertrained soldier doesn’t stay in the army: when training drops below 30%, the weak go back to being peasants or are sent to labor in the mines and on construction. New recruits lower the average; dojos, barracks and drills raise it.

    Classes and chain of command

    Provincial fortifications

    Your subjects build the defenses by hand. Each project needs peasant families and lowers the standard of living a little.

    Heirs

    An adult heir can succeed you. You will go on as a warrior of the clan, and the heir will lead the dynasty with all the property, provinces and army.

    Clan warriors

    Smiths and Army

    Raw materials and the tatara furnace

    Japanese steel is born from iron sand and charcoal. In a tatara furnace they burn for three days, and from the bloom that comes out the smiths pick the tamahagane, "the jewel steel", from which katanas, spears and armor are forged.

    Training

    Gear for the whole army

    Blades for the clan warriors

    The smith folds the steel again and again, coats the blade in clay and quenches it in water, creating the hamon line. Every blade improves the warrior.
